page.notes: Catchword "tus" is printed at the lower right and is kept out of the text. The word "faciût" is read as faciũt with a tilde over u and marked [?]. The printed hyphens at line ends ("Stoi-", "synthe-", "analy-", "progredieban-", "constitu-") are kept as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Ligatures and spacing in "Stoici" and "Quidnam" were checked against the scan.
